svg.text: EXAMPLE ONLY: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DATA, NOT A REAL EVALUATION
1. 2 disparity metrics exceed threshold; review model equity.
2. Residual bias present: the model under-predicts for the Female group.
3. Cohen's d between Male/Female is medium (0.35); investigate.
Whether a regression model produces equitable error distributions across groups (MAE, RMSE, R-squared
parity and effect sizes). Each disparity metric passes under its threshold; Cohen's d effect sizes show
the practical magnitude of any error gap. EXAMPLE ONLY, synthetic demonstration data, not a real
evaluation. Regression fairness: 2/4 disparity metrics pass across 3 groups; failing: MAE Parity, Mean
Pred Diff. Address the failing metrics and the largest error-gap effect sizes.
